title: Expressing Past Actions
subject: English Language
objectives: Talk about actions that happened in the past

blocks.md:
When we talk about things that happened **yesterday**, **last week**, or **on Saturday**, we use **past tense verbs**.

- **ate** (not eat)
- **played** (not play)
- **went** (not go)
- **learnt** (not learn)
- **watched** (not watch)
- **asked** (not ask)
- **gave** (not give)
- **saw** (not see)

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: John ate rice yesterday. The boys played football last Monday. We went to the market on Saturday. We learnt the alphabets last week.

lines.speaker: Jide
lines.text: Kunle, which comic did you watch on Saturday?

lines.speaker: Jide
lines.text: Mohammed, where did you go on Friday?

lines.speaker: Akpan
lines.text: Ngozi, what did Mr. Jackson tell us to do?

lines.speaker: Ngozi
lines.text: Mr. Jackson told us to sing the national anthem.

lines.speaker: Ayo
lines.text: Emeka, what did you ask Jibril?

lines.speaker: Emeka
lines.text: I asked him for a pencil.

lines.speaker: Jibril
lines.text: Mohammed, did you buy this ball?

lines.speaker: Mohammed
lines.text: No, I did not. My friend gave it to me.

lines.speaker: Jide
lines.text: Akpan, did you see Mr. Jackson?

lines.speaker: Akpan
lines.text: Yes, he went towards his office.

blocks.md: **Rule:** Past tense verbs describe actions that already happened. 'I go' (now) → 'I went' (yesterday).

quiz.explain: The teacher said 'John ate rice yesterday.'

quiz.q: Where did Mohammed go on Friday?
What did Emeka ask Jibril for?
quiz.explain: Emeka asked Jibril for a pencil.
